excluded: No web booking application, persistence, simultaneous threads, payment, account login, arbitrary dependencies or network calls in the contestant task. These can be later task packs.

requirements.BOOK-01: A successful booking reserves exactly seats; capacity can never be exceeded.
requirements.BOOK-02: Insufficient capacity returns False and leaves the entire reservation state unchanged; group bookings are all-or-nothing.
requirements.BOOK-03: Cancelling an existing reservation returns True, removes it and releases exactly its booked seats.
requirements.BOOK-04: Cancelling an unknown or already-cancelled ID returns False and changes nothing.
requirements.BOOK-05: An already-active booking ID returns False and changes nothing. A cancelled ID may be reused.
requirements.BOOK-06: book returns False without mutation for empty/non-string ID, non-integer seats (including bool), or seats <=0. cancel with empty/non-string ID also returns False without mutation.
requirements.BOOK-07: available() equals capacity minus all active seats; reservations() returns the active ID-to-seat mapping. Different BookingSystem instances do not share bookings.
